svg.title: The cut gate opens and releases water into a safe diversion channel.
svg.desc: Babul-da and unseen site workers pull the released gate leaf while Ila directs residents towards higher ground. Water surges through the new gap as Cecil records the physical result.
svg.text: Page 49, panel 4 · Dynamic low view as the barrier joint is cut

text.tspan: The gate opens and releases the trapped water
without erasing who authorised the damage.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
